title: M2.1 Combat-feel: trigger-element HUD (show which element is on RT vs LT)
description: Playtest feedback: it's not clear what element is bound to which trigger. Today scripts/ui/player_hud.gd shows a PRIMARY swatch+label (prominent) and SECONDARY swatch+label (smaller) using ProjectileStyle colors, but NOTHING tells the player that RT fires PRIMARY and LT fires SECONDARY. Add an explicit, readable trigger->element binding to the HUD: label/icon each loadout slot with its trigger (PRIMARY = 'RT', SECONDARY = 'LT'), keeping the element color language (Fire warm / Ice cold / Electricity arc per game-design Readable-VFX). Keep it greybox-appropriate (text/ColorRect, no new art). Should update live via the existing magic_manager.loadout_changed signal (player_hud already listens). Keep it legible and uncluttered (game-design: juice must never bury the read). This is UI only; do not touch combat/casting logic. Honor godot-game-dev (HUD/CanvasLayer hygiene) + game-design (readability). Tests-first: extend test_player_hud / test_player_hud_feedback to assert the trigger labels exist, are bound to the correct slot, and reflect the current element + color on loadout_changed.
acceptance_criteria: The player HUD shows, for each loadout slot, BOTH the trigger that fires it (PRIMARY=RT, SECONDARY=LT) AND the current element (name + color), updating live on loadout_changed.
Color language matches ProjectileStyle (single source of truth shared with projectiles); legible greybox (no new art assets).
UI only: no change to casting/combat logic or other scenes; arena/sector_01/sector_02 still load clean.
Tests-first; HUD tests assert the trigger->element binding + color + live update; full GUT suite green exit 0 run multiple times; gdlint clean.
